intro: Eritrea is a one-party state led by Isaias Afwerki since independence.

chapters.title: How it works
text: No national elections have been held since independence, and the constitution has never been put into force. There is no independent press. National service can last for years.

chapters.title: Region
text: Relations with Ethiopia have become tense again.
